project.title: easy-gpui-l10n
project.tagline: CSV-first localization for Rust and GPUI, inspired by Flutter easy_localization.

summary.short: easy-gpui-l10n is a CSV-first localization crate for Rust and GPUI with runtime translation, fallback locales, placeholders, and generated JSON or Fluent locale files.
summary.long: The crate keeps translation data in a reusable core independent from GPUI, supports dot-notation keys, runtime placeholders, missing-key fallback behavior, JSON and Fluent generation, and optional GPUI global integration.

highlights: Optional GPUI integration with frontend-neutral core
